title: FLOORA: A Human-Aligned Domain-Specific Language Model for Architectural Design
abstract: arXiv:2609.36064v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Foundation models are powerful generators, but many engineering domains require structured representations that general-purpose systems handle poorly. We introduce FLOORA (Floor Layout Optimization with RL Alignment), a family of small domain-specific language (DSL) models for architectural layout generation. With specialized data and alignment, our 0.6B model outperforms much larger frontier models, achieving VLM judge win rates up to 92.0% on out-of-distribution real-world buildings and 96.0% on synthetic buildings. Human evaluations further corroborate these results, with FLOORA selected as the best model in 89.3% of evaluations. FLOORA combines a token-efficient DSL, custom tokenization, domain-specific pretraining, supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and reinforcement learning (RL) with learned human-preference and verifiable rewards. translated_title: FLOORA：面向建筑设计的、与人类偏好对齐的领域专用语言模型
translated_abstract: 基础模型是强大的生成器，但许多工程领域需要通用系统难以妥善处理的结构化表示。我们提出了FLOORA（基于强化学习对齐的楼层布局优化），这是一系列用于建筑布局生成的小型领域专用语言（DSL）模型。通过专用数据和对齐技术，我们的0.6B参数模型超越了规模大得多的前沿模型，在分布外的真实建筑上实现了高达92.0%的VLM（视觉语言模型）评判胜率，在合成建筑上达到96.0%。人类评估进一步证实了这些结果，FLOORA在89.3%的评估中被选为最佳模型。FLOORA结合了令牌高效的DSL、自定义分词器、领域专用预训练、监督微调（SFT）以及结合学习的人类偏好奖励与可验证奖励的强化学习（RL）。这一流程提升了建筑与几何的合理性，并得到了大量实证评估的支持。
tldr: FLOORA是一个仅0.6B参数的建筑布局生成领域专用语言模型，通过令牌高效的DSL设计、领域专用预训练、监督微调以及结合人类偏好与可验证奖励的强化学习，在真实与合成建筑布局生成任务上大幅超越规模大得多的通用前沿模型。
en_tdlr: FLOORA is a family of 0.6B domain-specific language models for architectural layout generation that, through token-efficient DSL design, domain-specific pretraining, SFT, and RL alignment with human preferences and verifiable rewards, outperforms much larger frontier models on both real-world and synthetic buildings.
